# IP-05 Brief — Final Audit

## Objective

Independently audit `docs/implementation-plan.md` against all accepted reports and authoritative sources.

## Output

Write only `docs/.rwang-tasks/CR12-FEAT34/IP-05-final-audit.md`.

## Hard-gate rubric

- Completeness: all mandated plan sections and implementation-plan skill requirements are present.
- Traceability: requirements, packages, tests, gates, and evidence map bidirectionally.
- Consistency: no contradiction with CR-012, FEAT34, API/design contracts, frontend execution plan, preflight, or graph.
- Capacity: no sprint exceeds effective capacity and contingency is at least 25 percent.
- Safety: tenant/RBAC/PII/audit/fail-closed/no-deception boundaries remain explicit.
- Truthfulness: planned and implemented states are not conflated; critical preflight and MSP blockers remain visible.
- Graph handoff: identify the exact node/edge/status/hash changes the controller should make; do not edit the graph.

Verdict must be `PASS`, `FAIL`, or `NEEDS REVISION` with actionable findings.
